name: cutout-to-mask
summary: Separate the subject from its background with a layer mask (nothing is deleted).
when: Product or subject on a fairly plain background that needs a transparent or new background.
photoshop: Select > Subject, Select and Mask (refine edge), then Layer > Layer Mask > Reveal Selection
notes: PhotoCraft's Select Subject is classical (graph cut), not ML: it works on clear contrast, struggles on busy backgrounds. Check the mask over black and over white.
